query: SELECT d.id, d.name, d.address, d.port, d.intermittent, rh.id AS "repo_host_id?", COALESCE(rh.wake_enabled, d.wake_enabled) AS "wake_enabled!", CASE WHEN rh.id IS NULL THEN d.wake_mac_address ELSE rh.wake_mac_address END AS wake_mac_address, CASE WHEN rh.id IS NULL THEN d.wake_broadcast_address ELSE rh.wake_broadcast_address END AS wake_broadcast_address, COALESCE(rh.wake_timeout_seconds, d.wake_timeout_seconds) AS "wake_timeout_seconds!" FROM dependency_hosts d LEFT JOIN repo_hosts rh ON rh.id = d.repo_host_id WHERE d.id IN (SELECT dependency_host_id FROM schedule_dependencies WHERE schedule_id = $1 AND agent_id = $2 UNION SELECT dependency_host_id FROM agent_default_dependencies WHERE agent_id = $2) ORDER BY d.name
